三: sān — three; (before a verb) three times, on three counts
主: zhǔ — host, master; to take as the chief thing
之: zhī — (1) object pronoun: it, him, them; (2) genitive 'of', ''s'; (3) between subject and verb, turns a clause into a noun; (4) marks a fronted object
乎: hū — (1) final question particle; (2) preposition 'from, than, at' (= 於)
乘: shèng — chariot (a four-horse war chariot, counted as a measure of a state's size); read chéng 'to ride'
也: yě — final particle of assertion; after a topic, a pause: 'as for…'. Not modern 'also'.
交: jiāo — to associate with, to deal with
亦: yì — also, too; indeed (in 不亦…乎 'is it not indeed…?')
人: rén — others (as against oneself); a person, people
仁: rén — humaneness: the quality that makes one fully human toward others; (as a noun for people) the humane
令: lìng — fine, good (as in polite address); to command
以: yǐ — by means of, with, according to; thereby
何如: hé rú — how is it? what about…? (a fixed question: 'what would you say of…')
作: zuò — to start, to raise up, to make
使: shǐ — to employ, to make (someone) do
來: lái — to come; what is to come
信: xìn — good faith, being true to one's word; trustworthy; a promise given
傳: chuán — to hand on; what is handed down, the teaching received; read zhuàn 'a commentary'
先王: xiān wáng — the former kings: the sage rulers of antiquity (Yao, Shun, Yu, Wen, Wu)
入: rù — to go in; at home
其: qí — his, her, its, their; (at the head of a sentence) perhaps, surely
其諸: qí zhū — perhaps, surely (a tentative particle; Zhu Xi: 語辭)
出: chū — to go out; abroad, out in the world
務: wù — to work at, to devote effort to
千乘: qiān shèng — a thousand chariots; 千乘之國 'a state of a thousand chariots', a major feudal state
友: yǒu — a friend; to befriend, to take as friend
君子: jūn zǐ — the gentleman; literally 'a lord's son', a man of noble birth — in the Analects, a man of cultivated character, whoever his father
和: hé — harmony; ease, being relaxed and unforced; to harmonize
因: yīn — to rely on, to depend on (Zhu Xi: 依)
固: gù — firm, solid; obstinate, blinkered (Kong Anguo's reading of 學則不固)
國: guó — a state, a feudal domain
在: zài — to be present, to be alive
夏: xià — Xia, in the name Zixia; summer
夫: fū — a man; in 夫子, 'that master'; read fú as an opening particle
夫子: fū zǐ — the Master: how the disciples speak of Confucius (夫 'that' + 子 'master')
好: hào — to be fond of, to love; read hǎo 'good'
如: rú — to be like, to come up to; as, like
始: shǐ — at last, for the first time; to begin
威: wēi — awe, dignity that commands respect
子: zǐ — the Master (alone as speaker, always Confucius); a son, a child; an honorific 'Master' after a surname
子夏: zǐ xià — Zixia: the disciple Bu Shang 卜商, known for his learning in the texts
子禽: zǐ qín — Ziqin: Chen Kang 陳亢, a disciple of Confucius or (some say) of Zigong
子貢: zǐ gòng — Zigong: the disciple Duanmu Ci 端木賜, eloquent and rich from trade
孝: xiào — filial devotion: serving one's parents well, in life and after death
學: xué — to learn; learning (by study and by imitation of those who know)
宗: zōng — to take as chief, to look up to as head (Zhu Xi: 主); the ancestral line
就: jiù — to go to, to approach
居: jū — to dwell, to live; a dwelling
已: yǐ — final particle: 'and that is all', finality; to stop
弟: tì — deference to elders, a younger brother's duty (later written 悌); read dì 'younger brother'
弟子: dì zǐ — the young (literally 'younger brothers and sons'); elsewhere, a master's disciples
往: wǎng — to go; what has gone, the past
復: fù — to go back over; to make good (one's word)
德: dé — virtue: moral quality, the inner worth that shows in conduct
志: zhì — intent, what the heart is set on
忠: zhōng — wholehearted, giving all of oneself (Zhu Xi: 盡己); later, loyalty to a ruler
患: huàn — to be troubled by, to worry about
慍: yùn — to resent, to bear a smouldering grudge
憚: dàn — to dread, to shrink from
所: suǒ — that which, where (makes a verb phrase into a noun)
政: zhèng — government, the conduct of government
敬: jìng — reverent, respectful; to treat with reverent care
文: wén — pattern; letters, the literary culture (the Odes, the Documents, the six arts)
方: fāng — a region, a quarter, a direction
於: yú — at, in, to, from; than (preposition)
易: yì — to exchange, to replace; easy
時: shí — in season, at the proper time; time and again (Zhu Xi on 時習)
曾: zēng — Zeng, a surname (read céng 'once, ever')
曾子: zēng zǐ — Master Zeng: the disciple Zeng Shen 曾參, one of the youngest, called 'Master' like You Ruo
有: yǒu — to have; there is, there are
有子: yǒu zǐ — Master You: the disciple You Ruo 有若, one of only two disciples the Analects calls 'Master'
朋: péng — companion, friend; Bao Xian: 同門曰朋, fellow pupils of one master
朋友: péng yǒu — friends (朋 companions of one's own kind + 友 those one befriends)
樂: lè — joyful, to take joy in; read yuè 'music', yào 'to delight in'
正: zhèng — to correct, to set straight; upright
歸: guī — to return, to go home to
民: mín — the people, the common folk
求: qiú — to seek, to ask for
沒: mò — to sink; to die (read méi 'not have' in modern Mandarin)
溫: wēn — warm, gentle (Zhu Xi: 和厚, mild and generous)
為: wéi — to do, to practise; to act as, count as, be; read wèi 'for (the sake of)'
焉: yān — in it, by them (the fused 於之); a final particle
無: wú — not to have, without; = 毋 'do not!' (prohibitive)
父母: fù mǔ — father and mother, one's parents
犯: fàn — to offend against, to defy
生: shēng — to grow, to be born, to arise
由: yóu — to follow, to go by; from
省: xǐng — to examine, to look into; read shěng 'to reduce, a province'
矣: yǐ — final particle: the situation is reached, settled — 'and so it is'
知: zhī — to know, to recognize (a person's worth); to understand
磋: cuō — to file, to rasp smooth (bone or horn)
禮: lǐ — the rites: ceremony, ritual, the whole body of right custom and manners
禽: qín — Qin, in the name Ziqin; a bird
立: lì — to stand, to be established
竭: jié — to exhaust, to use up entirely
節: jié — to measure, to keep within bounds (from 'a joint of bamboo')
終: zhōng — the end; (here) the end of a parent's life and its rites
義: yì — what is right, what fits the case (Zhu Xi: 事之宜)
習: xí — to rehearse, to practise over and over (the graph has 羽 'wings': a fledgling practising flight)
者: zhě — the one(s) who, those who: turns what precedes into a noun
而: ér — and, and then; and yet, but (links two verbs or clauses)
聞: wén — to hear, to learn of
至: zhì — to arrive at, to reach
致: zhì — to deliver up, to give over entirely
與: yǔ — with; to give; read yú, a final question particle (later written 歟)
良: liáng — good; straightforward (Zhu Xi: 易直, easy and direct)
色: sè — colour; the face's colour, countenance; beauty, female charm
若: ruò — to be like, to equal
衆: zhòng — the many, everyone (variant form of 眾)
行: xíng — to do, to put into practice; conduct (Zhu Xi reads the noun xìng); to work, to go
親: qīn — to draw close to; those one should be close to; kin
言: yán — words, speech; to speak, to talk about
詩: shī — the Odes (the Book of Songs, 305 ancient poems); a poem
說: yuè — to be pleased, delighted (the word later written 悅); read shuō 'to speak, explain', shuì 'to persuade'
諸: zhū — the fused 之於 'it to, it at'; all, the various
謀: móu — to plan, to lay plans
謂: wèi — to call (something so); to mean, to refer to
貢: gòng — Gong, in the name Zigong; tribute
賜: cì — Ci, Zigong's personal name; to bestow
賢: xián — worthy; the worthy; to treat as worthy, to esteem
身: shēn — body; one's own person, oneself
追: zhuī — to follow after, to pursue; to honour the dead with offerings
過: guò — to overstep; to err, a fault
道: dào — the Way; a way, a path; read dǎo 'to lead, to govern' (later written 導)
遠: yuǎn — far, distant; as a verb, to keep at a distance (Zhu Xi reads the verb yuàn)
重: zhòng — heavy, weighty; gravity of bearing; read chóng 'again, double'
食: shí — to eat; food (read sì 'to feed')
